summaries.zh: 开源健身房与自身体重追踪器，支持制定训练计划、记录训练（含超级组、热身、有氧），显示肌肉训练、疲劳或退化状态，可导入FitNotes/Strong/Hevy数据，采用一次性密码登录。用户数据存储在自建服务器上。使用JavaScript开发，获得5496星和759次分叉。
summaries.en: DuarteSantos8/openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker app. It allows users to plan routines, log workouts (including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio), and monitor muscle status (trained, fatigued, or detrained). The app supports data import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy, with passkey login for security. Users can host their own server, ensuring data privacy. It is built with JavaScript and has 5,496 stars and 759 forks on its repository.
